text:
maria: quick FYI: the curl example in docs/onboarding/getting-started.md is hitting a 404 in staging. ran it straight from the page and got:
```
$ curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood-inference.test/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hey"}'
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
{"error":"endpoint not found"}
```
looks like the runtime docs moved the path to /runtime/v1/generate. who's the owner of that onboarding page?

doc-bot: auto-scan: example-failure detected in docs/onboarding/getting-started.md -> ticket DOCS-1241 created :mag:

devon: I can pick this up. plan: update the curl snippet to use /runtime/v1/generate, tweak the expected example response if needed, and add a tiny smoke test to docs CI so this doesn't regress.

samir: thanks. include the exact curl line you add to CI so I can run locally during review, and add a note in the PR explaining why changing the snippet is safe for hosted users (proxy preserves backwards compat).

devon: smoke test I'll add (staging):
```
# docs/ci/smoke/onboarding.sh
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}
' -X POST https://staging-api.redwood-inference.test/runtime/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'
# expect: 200
```
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1290 (snippet fix + ci test + changelog line)

olivia: thanks. release-ops note: ping me once it's ready to merge and tag me on the PR. we'll include in the next docs minor deploy window.

samir: i'll do CR. checklist: verify example response shape (top-level choices array), run the new smoke script locally, and ensure no other shortlinks remain on that page. also please add `closes DOCS-1241` in the PR body.

devon: updated the snippet and the example response to match runtime output. added docs/ci/smoke/onboarding.sh and a small CI job. pushed branch fix/onboarding-example.

doc-bot: CI: docs-smoke/onboarding.sh passed for branch fix/onboarding-example (run 9123) :white_check_mark:

maria: assigning docs ownership for that page to @devon for follow-up edits. i'll close DOCS-1241 after deploy is live. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

samir: one tiny nit: extra backtick in the markdown fenced block on line ~48. leaving a comment on the PR.

devon: fixed and force-pushed. PR updated.

doc-bot: deploy-bot queued minor docs deploy after merge.

olivia: sounds good. @samir when LGTM, merge and i'll coordinate deploy timing.

samir: LGTM, merging now.

doc-bot: docs PR merged and scheduled for next minor deploy.

maria: closing loop — great catch, and thanks for the quick turnaround.
